message:
feat(keepalive-multi r1): the table of kept PCs, and a connect gate per PC with process-unique numbers

SessionRegistry (pure): an entry per PC connection (key origin|account|hostId, its own
process-unique handle), one Active at a time, the rest Parked. Capacity (policy: 3 PCs
with the active one, proposed) is reserved in one step with the count; at the limit the
Parked entry used longest ago is marked and closes only when the new connection commits
-- a failed connection unmarks it (no eviction from failures), a victim used again is
spared and the next parked LRU gives way. Each PC's park has its own deadline from its
BeginPark (5 min, proposed); only coming back and leaving again starts a new one. One
PC's ending leaves the others; EndAll moves the lifecycle epoch (reservations made
before it are refused).
ConnectOpGate: numbers from one process-wide counter, cancel per gate -- B's new
operation no longer stops parked A's steps.
session_registry_test 31/0 (A<->B round trip, limit 3 and 2, 5 failed attempts = 0
evictions, racing reservations never above the limit, independent TTLs, endings, one
active); connect_op_gate_test 43/0 with [13] per-PC cancel. Negative controls: the
0.2.30 single park ends A when B opens; a single gate stops A's step.

제품/테스트/문서: 제품(native, 아직 브리지에 연결 전) + 테스트
